items.title: Why Is Fifth Third Bancorp (FITB) Renaming A Historic Detroit Ballpark?
items.summary: Fifth Third Bancorp (NYSE:FITB) and the Detroit Tigers agreed to rename Comerica Park as Fifth Third Park following the Comerica merger. The new naming rights arrangement highlights Fifth Third's push to deepen its presence and identity across Michigan communities. Planned fan engagement programs at Fifth Third Park are set to include new in-park experiences and community-focused activations.
